headline: My $2,000 E-Bike Was Lost, But the Real Nightmare Was AI Chatbot Hell
reasoning: This topic scores exceptionally high on clickability and mainstream appeal by tapping into a universal, modern frustration with automated customer service. The personal story of a significant financial loss makes it highly relatable and shareable, and the subject lends itself perfectly to multiple engaging formats, from a personal essay to a 'how-to-beat-the-bots' listicle.
summary: A customer's expensive e-bike delivery went missing, and their attempt to get help resulted in a months-long, unresolved battle against incompetent AI chatbots from FedEx, the retailer, and their bank. The story serves as a powerful case study on the failures of current AI-driven customer support.

source_articles.title: My Ebike Delivery Went Missing. When I Tried to Recover It, I Ended Up in Chatbot Hell
source_articles.excerpt: Companies’ increasing reliance on AI chatbots isn’t making the customer service experience smarter. It’s just making it more infuriating.
